# Synthetic fixtures

The local test server generates a 60-second, low-amplitude 220 Hz mono WAV and
18 timed passages of authored example text. It also generates an alternative
transcript and a legacy OHMS sync example. They contain no recordings, personal
names, collection metadata, or external media.

`synthetic.webm` is a silent 96 × 64 solid-color video generated by 3DH Lab from a
canvas, encoded as VP8 with Chromium MediaRecorder and extended to 60 seconds by
FFmpeg stream copying. It contains no camera footage. It is distributed under
this repository's GPL-3.0 license for native-video regression testing.
